title: The Morning Digest: October 6, 2026
dek: WTI hovered near $89.33 overnight while Brent held around $100.28; Saudi Aramco cut its Arab Light official price for Asia to a six-year low as Middle East exports beat pre-war levels four days last week. The diesel crack settled back above $100 Monday ($101.47). Today's binary: SPR exchange bids due 11:00 a.m. Central.
